subject: Quick SEO win for Rajnoop Law
body:
Hi Rajnoop Law team,

I was looking at your website and noticed a few quick SEO wins that are costing you traffic:

1. Missing meta description tag in HTML
2. Missing structured schema markup (JSON-LD)
3. Thin homepage content (15 words; recommend 600+ words to rank)

Rank Ray can fix these in under 48 hours. Want to see a free detailed video audit?

Best,
Rank Ray Team

Thin homepage content (15 words; recommend 600+ words to rank)
